about: Turns labelled with the kind of exchange each one is — social, playful, personal, brainstorm, discussion, disagreement, conversation, task — graded offline, with no model, against the runtime's own reading (lib/runtime/state.ts readTurnState → lib/cognition/register.ts readExchange) by test/logos5-eval.test.mjs and evals/logos5/run.mjs. 'after' is the turn before it, [theirs, Socria's], where the reading depends on Socria having said something. Written alongside the reader: a regression check and a statement of intent, not an independent benchmark.
